# Learning module title

**For:** Learner and starting point  
**Time:** Estimated completion time  
**You will learn:** What the participant will understand or do differently

Use one sentence to explain why this learning matters in a situation the participant will recognize.

## Scenario

Describe a realistic situation in the present tense. Invite the participant to notice, decide, or respond before introducing the key ideas.

> **Tip:** Add a short hint only when it helps the participant get started or unstuck.

## Exercise

Work through a short sequence with the participant to reveal the core idea and concepts. Introduce each idea when it becomes useful, invite the participant to notice what changes, and end with something they can inspect.

## Reflection

Use one or two open questions to help the participant connect the exercise to a current or recent experience. Invite a specific example, choice, or pattern rather than a general opinion.

## Takeaways and next step

Invite the participant to name the learning in their own words, check their work against a few clear prompts, and choose one small action they might try.

Place invisible learner-facing source markers beside mapped content. Tips may clarify or unstick the learner but must remain brief and optional. Do not include coach-directed content or the source contract.
